results.name: alleleFreqMismatchPenalty
results.regime: 3e6 individuals per population (30 blocks of 1e5) with an UNSTANDARDISED allele count Binomial(2, p) and a FIXED effect; the observable is the ratio of realised score-phenotype covariance in the target to that in the source. Three cells share |dp| = 0.2 at different places in the unit interval, which is the design that refuted the superseded exponential: a body seeing only the gap must return one number for all three. One cell moves a frequency TOWARD 0.5, where retention exceeds one
